📈 When you make your own plot, it saves so you can come back anytime! If it doesn’t load, just rejoin and try again.
🎮 Blocks is a fun and easy sandbox voxel building simulator! Build cool houses, towers, and anything you can imagine. Show off your creativity, play with friends, chat, and explore. It’s the perfect place for builders of all ages!
